shared_elements: large upright anthropomorphic monolith/pillar carved in low relief
stylised bird or bird-like creature in profile
horizontal band or belt dividing the surface
disc or circular element on the torso
arms/hands rendered in low relief on the body
small quadrupeds or animals arranged in a row across the upper zone
justification: Both are monumental upright anthropomorphic slabs whose body surface carries low-relief animals (birds in profile, quadrupeds), zigzag/chevron fields, a horizontal belt-like band and a disc, with arms rendered flat against the body — a fairly specific shared scheme rather than a generic one. The clearest differences are that A has a sculpted three-dimensional head with facial features and a broad rounded body, while B's imagery is confined to a flat panel with a register of repeated animals along the top and a large bird-and-snake motif lower down, so the specific creature identities and their groupings do not match closely.
